notes.title: Update to version 1.22
notes.notes:
[b]This update brings the prologue up to date with the main game. [/b]For a list of changes see this post: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2207470/view/6756037289820308569?l=english]Update 1.2 Fate[/url]

[b]Note:[/b] most of the new features are not available in the prologue, but there are many bugfixes and balance changes that should make the prologue more enjoyable to play.

notes.title: Update to version 1.04
notes.notes:
Hi all,

today we are releasing our regular weekly update. Most changes are either bugfixes or quality of life improvements:

[list]
[*] [b]Tooltips [/b]- we added tooltips to most UI elements throughout the game to help explain what certain things do
[*] Buildings that create units now have a [b]icon above them indicating when the next unit will be created[/b]
[*] [b]Game pause[/b] - several players asked for a way to pause the game so we added a new ability to all gods - [b]freeze time![/b] To use it, press SpaceBar (or "Y" on your controller) and the time will stop, but you will be able to move around and interact with the UI (read tooltips) etc.
[*] After loading finishes when entering a region you will now need to press a key to continue - this will allow you to read tips and prepare for battle (unlike before where you have been thrown into it without warning)
[*] [b]Improved targeting of spells[/b] - when shooting buildings, projectiles will now hit the exact spot you chose, not the center of the building
[*] Many smaller fixes and improvements
[/list]

Hopefully you find these improvements useful!

Thanks,
Peter

notes.title: Release pending Steam approval
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[b]Unfortunately we have some sad news - the release of the Prologue will have to wait a bit[/b], possibly a few days. The reason for this is that[b] Steam seems to be having some problems with the build[/b] and we are still missing the approval for it, even though it was submitted for review almost two weeks ago.

We are in contact with Steam support, but the answer so far is "you will have to wait a few more days". So I guess this is what we have to do.

[b]Rest assured that as soon as we get the approval, we will release the prologue immediately.[/b] The game is ready and includes new content and prologue specific achievements for those who are into that :)

Best regards,
Peter
